SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.BOARD_NO , B.BOARD_TITLE , B.BOARD_CATEGORY , B.REG_DATE , B.VIEW_COUNT , M.MEMBER_NAME , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BOARD_LIKE L WHERE L.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM TB_BOARD B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.REF_MNO
ORDER BY B.VIEW_COUNT DESC, B.REG_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT B.BOARD_NO , B.BOARD_TITLE , B.BOARD_CATEGORY , B.REG_DATE , B.VIEW_COUNT , M.MEMBER_NAME , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BOARD_LIKE L WHERE L.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM TB_BOARD B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.REF_MNO
ORDER BY B.REG_DATE DESC ) A ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOARD SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT B.BOARD_NO , B.BOARD_TITLE , B.BOARD_CATEGORY , B.BOARD_CONTENT , B.REG_DATE , B.VIEW_COUNT , M.MEMBER_NAME , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BOARD_LIKE L WHERE L.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT
, A.ATTACHMENT_PATH
, C.COMMENT_NO , C.COMMENT_CONTENT , C.REG_DATE AS COMMENT_DATE , CM.MEMBER_NAME AS COMMENT_WRITER
FROM TB_BOARD B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.REF_MNO
LEFT JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT A ON A.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO AND A.STATUS = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN TB_COMMENT C ON C.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO AND C.STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER CM ON CM.MEMBER_NO = C.REF_MNO
WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY C.REG_DATE ASC
